proposed.text: Under RA 10884 (Balanced Housing Development Program, 2016), private subdivision developers must dedicate a share of socialized housing. Which percentage applies to a subdivision project?

options.text: 5% of total subdivision area or project cost
15% of total subdivision area or project cost
20% of total subdivision area or project cost
30% of total subdivision area or project cost

rationale.a: Wrong. 5% applies to condominium projects under RA 10884, not subdivisions.
rationale.b: Correct. RA 10884 Section 2(b) sets the subdivision socialized-housing allocation at 15% of total area or project cost at the developer's option.
rationale.c: Wrong. 20% was the original RA 7279 (1992) figure; RA 10884 (2016) reduced it to 15% for subdivisions.
rationale.d: Wrong. 30% is the PD 1216/PD 957 non-buildable open space requirement, not a balanced-housing figure.
rationale.correct: RA 10884 (2016) amended RA 7279 Section 18: subdivision projects require at least 15% of total area or project cost (at developer option); condominium projects require at least 5%.
rationale.takeaway: RA 10884 reduced RA 7279's 20% subdivision share to 15%. The figure is a fixed 15% (or 5% for condominiums), not a range.

proposed.explanation: RA 10884 Section 2(b) amends RA 7279 Section 18: subdivisions = at least 15% of total area or project cost; condominiums = at least 5%.
